newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee eases as Reserve Bank buys dollars.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee eases as Reserve Bank buys dollars.

text.p: The rupee eased mildly against the dollar on Monday afternoon after the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) intervened in the inter-bank market, dealers said.
The RBI bought dollars at 35.73 rupees, they said.
The rupee opened the day steady at 35.71/72, dealers said. It was steady throughout the morning, perked up by the State Bank of India (SBI)'s dollar purchases, they said.
After SBI withdrew, the rupee edged up to 35.7050/7100 and was expected to test the 35.70-mark again, dealers said.
The RBI entered at this juncture, and bought up to the 35.73 level. Spot dollar ended the day at 35.72/73 rupees.
